Name: Extra Sharp Weapons(update)
Author: bingfengkushao
Description:
这个模组实际上是[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3516]Extra Sharp Weaponry[/url]的 CP 更新，使观察者/亡命徒成为一条可行的战斗职业道路。
但是我自己做了一些个人的改变。
这个模组按比例提高了原版中所有武器的暴击率。
大多数情况下，暴击率变化如下：
0% -> 10%，
1% -> 15%，
2% -> 20%，
3% -> 25%，
4% -> 30%，
5% -> 35%，
6% -> 40%，
10% -> 50%。
当然，也有一些例外：
熔岩武士刀（作为普通矿山的终极武器）：1.5%->25%，
银河剑和无尽之剑：2%->45%，
银河匕首和无限匕首：2%/6%->45%，
银河之锤和无限木槌：2%->40%。
终极武器之所以有45%的暴击命中率，是因为如果你有一个暴击附魔，佩戴两个加暴击的戒指，再加上一个暴击职业，就可以实现100%的暴击，一击瞬间击杀敌方怪物。

This mod is actually a CP update for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3516]Extra Sharp Weaponry[/url], making Scout/Desperado a viable combat career path.
But I made some personal changes myself.
This module proportionally increases the critical hit rate of all weapons in the original version.
In most cases, the change in critical hit rate is as follows:
0% -> 10%，
1% -> 15%，
2% -> 20%，
3% -> 25%，
4% -> 30%，
5% -> 35%，
6% -> 40%，
10% -> 50%.
Of course, there are also some exceptions:
熔岩武士刀（As the ultimate weapon of ordinary mines）：1.5%->25%，
Galaxy Sword and Infinity Blade：2%->45%，
Galaxy Dagger and Iridium Needle：2%/6%->45%，
Galaxy Hammer and Infinity Gavel：2%->40%.
The reason why the ultimate weapon has a critical hit rate of 45% is because if you have a critical enchantment, wear two rings that add critical hits, and add a critical strike profession, you can achieve 100% critical hit and instantly kill enemy monsters with one strike.

Manifest.Description: Weapons have a higher critical hit rate.
